name: usda-companion
description: Outline, folding and tooling that fills the gaps of the Animal Logic USD highlighter for .usda files.

usda.usdcat.command.markdownDescription: Command used to run `usdcat` (flatten/preview). Wrap it in your studio launcher if needed, e.g. `["rez-env", "usd", "--", "usdcat"]`.

usda.python.command.markdownDescription: Python command that can `from pxr import Usd`. Used by upcoming schema/composition features (P1+).

usda.assetResolver.command.markdownDescription: Command that resolves an asset path (e.g. a custom `asset:` URI) to a filesystem path; the path is appended as the final argument. Default `usdresolve`. Must run in an environment where your resolver plugin is loaded (the same one where `usdchecker` resolves your custom scheme); wrap it like the other tools if needed.

usda.schema.generatedSchemaPaths.markdownDescription: Paths to `generatedSchema.usda` files describing custom schemas, used as a fallback for schema-aware completion/hover when those types aren't available from the configured Python.

usda.fold.propertyGroups.markdownDescription: Property-name namespace prefixes whose **consecutive** declarations collapse as a single fold region (great for long `collection:*` or `material:binding*` blocks). Matching is by the start of the property name, so `material:binding` also covers `material:binding:collection:*`. Add your studio's render-param binding prefix here.

usda.lint.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable fast text-based lints (xformOpOrder ↔ defined `xformOp:*` consistency, duplicate `def` siblings). No USD runtime required.

usda.diagnostics.usdcheckerOnSave.markdownDescription: Run `usdchecker` (via `usda.usdchecker.command`) on save and show its findings inline in the Problems panel. Requires the resolver environment (the same one where `usdchecker` resolves your assets).

usda.jumpToUsd.include.markdownDescription: Globs / extensions recognised as USD by **USDA: Jump to USD File**. The command first looks at your **open editor tabs**; if none are USD it falls back to searching the workspace folder(s) with these globs. Add `**/*.usdc` / `**/*.usdz` to also match binary crates.

usda.jumpToUsd.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs excluded from **USDA: Jump to USD File** search.

usda.jumpToUsd.openBestWhenMultiple.markdownDescription: When several USD files match (open tabs or folder search), open the best one directly instead of showing a picker. For folder search the score favours files at the root, files whose name matches the folder, and `.usda` over `.usd`; for open tabs it picks the first.

usda.deactivations.pruneEmptyParents.markdownDescription: After deleting deactivation blocks (`active = false`), also remove the `over` scaffolding that held them if it is now empty (e.g. a leftover `over "Vars" {}`). Only `over` prims that were ancestors of a deleted block, carry no metadata of their own, and end up with an empty body are removed.

usda.deactivations.groupPrefix.markdownDescription: Prim-name prefix that splits the **List deactivated Vars** picker (`Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+P`) in two: prims whose name starts with it are listed in a first section, everything else in a second. The picker's title button ticks that first group in one click. Matching is case-sensitive; set to an empty string to list everything ungrouped.
